items.text: Carolina (Thu practice): DNP - LB Bobby Okereke (foot, also missed Wk9; the only player held out). Limited - EDGE Jaelan Phillips (hamstring), G Damien Lewis (knee). Full - CB Will Lee III (hamstring) and everyone else listed, incl. CB Mike Jackson, RB Jonathon Brooks, WR Xavier Legette (IR return windows). Still out per earlier reports: IR - CB Jaycee Horn, OT Taylor Moton; PUP - OT Ikem Ekwonu. Bryce Young expected to start.

New Orleans (Thu practice): OUT - C Erik McCoy (biceps; Moore says out Sunday, Cesar Ruiz to C, rookie Jeremiah Wright at RG). DNP - RB CJ Donaldson (shoulder), DT Christen Miller (knee, downgraded). Limited - RB Travis Etienne Jr. (hamstring, IR, practicing toward activation), OT Kelvin Banks Jr. (ankle), G David Edwards (knee), CB Martin Emerson Jr. (shin), OT Taliese Fuaga (knee, new), CB Quincy Riley (knee, new). Full - RB Alvin Kamara, TE Noah Fant. Tyler Shough expected to start.
items.source: Crescent City Sports (Kamara practices Thursday, Ruiz to start at center, Nov 12)

adjust.reason: Carolina remains without both starting tackles, CB Jaycee Horn and likely LB Bobby Okereke, a heavier cluster than New Orleans missing C Erik McCoy with several linemen limited. The stats model doesn't price non-QB injuries
